primitivePolicy.finiteNeighborInput: Exact adjacent IEEE word required; a finite maximum may step to an infinity sentinel.
primitivePolicy.nonfiniteInput: Fallback reason nonfinite required; infinity sentinels are never valid finite interval endpoints.
primitivePolicy.finiteArithmetic: A finite returned interval must enclose the full exact-real endpoint range; conservative fallback is allowed.
primitivePolicy.signedZero: Word stepping preserves IEEE ordering conventions; interval endpoints are compared as exact real dyadics.

pairPolicy.preparation: Regenerate complete native preparation independently from raw words. Preserve raw-nonfinite, raw-force, preparation rejection precedence and retained prepared value.
pairPolicy.fastZero: Only an existing zero branch may be returned, with exact original branch precedence and exact zero interval shape.
pairPolicy.fallback: Complete candidate result must equal the unchanged baseline result, and each result must independently satisfy the fixed192 oracle.
pairPolicy.status: All fixed96 unresolved statuses fail qualification, including unresolved-range, normalizer, and cap. They are never accepted by substituting a positive or rejected fixed192 oracle outcome. Every fixed192 reference-undecidable outcome also fails qualification. There are no stress exceptions.
pairPolicy.positive: All five fixed96 intervals K, scaledK, beta, nu, coefficient must enclose the independent fixed192 reference; nonnegative bounds, K and scaledK upper bounds at most128, and positive nu lower bound are mandatory.

storage.format: Compact ASCII JSON in retained insertion order, exactly one newline per document or journal event; raw-byte SHA256 pins.

controls.policy: Fixed recipes; semantic validation before equality or journal checks; every intended failure family and independent witness required. Controls reuse one precomputed independent oracle, do not execute the candidate, and preserve originals.

recipes.mutation: candidate fast zero neighbor and zero result
candidate fast zero upstream and zero result
candidate fast zero upstream and zero result

candidate fast zero neighbor and zero result
journal first row id receives -changed suffix

independentHelper.boundary: Only exact preparation/constants/oracle utilities used. Old case generation, main validation, controls and suites remain uncalled.

scope: One fixed finite scalar verification; no load solve, full-group timing, speedup, physical validation, moving dynamics, browser scale or novelty inference.
